    {
      "unit_ordinal": 2,
      "line": 3,
      "quote": "It can build, test and ship any codebase, reliably and at scale.",
      "diagnosis": "Claims universal codebase coverage and reliable operation at unspecified scale beyond the execution capabilities described.",
      "evidence": "Lines 17 and 33 condition execution on supported systems and a Linux container runtime. Line 19 explains repeatability mechanisms, but supplies no basis for universal codebase compatibility or scaling performance.",
      "source_function": "capability",
      "deletion_test": "Deleting this sentence removes the unsupported universal and scaling claims while preserving the platform definition and the specific delivery and execution capabilities described below."
    },
    {
      "unit_ordinal": 39,
      "line": 33,
      "quote": "Local and CI behavior are identical.",
      "diagnosis": "Guarantees behavioral equivalence without conditioning it on matching inputs and host dependencies.",
      "evidence": "Line 19 explicitly recognizes host dependencies, and line 31 keys operations by their inputs. These mechanisms support repeatability under matching conditions; they do not establish identical behavior across local and CI environments without those conditions.",
      "source_function": "capability",
      "deletion_test": "Deleting this sentence removes the unconditional equivalence guarantee while retaining the runtime requirement, supported operating environments, and concrete repeatability mechanisms."
    }
  ]
}
